note: Hand-judged by the benchmark author. A 'false positive' is listed here only if, on reading the code, it is a REAL defect that the labels failed to include. Everything else stays a false positive. Judgements lean conservative: arguable hardening suggestions (e.g. 'JSONDecodeError not handled' in clean_py_with_open) were NOT counted as valid.

valid_findings.clean_java_prepared::Potential Resource: The PreparedStatement is never closed and its ResultSet is returned, so the statement/connection resources leak. The 'clean' label was wrong.
valid_findings.h_go_nil_map::Uninitialized map: Correct diagnosis (the map is never initialised) reported at the declaration line (4) instead of the labeled write on line 6; outside the ±1 line tolerance, so it is scored as a miss plus a false positive in the strict numbers.
